marc:datafield.marc:subfield: PAPER BLOOMS : 25 Extraordinary Flowers to Make for Weddings, Celebrations & More

Craft 25 sophisticated flower designs that can be used as home, party, and wedding decorations with a fresh, contemporary style. These unique decorations have been created by accomplished paper artist Jeffery Rudell, whose work has been feature at Tiffany & Co. (Fifth Avenue) and The New York Botanical Garden, as well as in the pages of Elle Decor, Brides, and Good Housekeeping magazines. Full-size patterns and hundreds of step-by-step photos make it easy for you to construct the components: the various stems, petals, and foliage. You can easily change the look of the flowers simply by using different materials such as tissue, origami, rice, vellum and handmade paper. Photo inspiration pages will give you ideas for the many ways the flowers can be used, from cheerful cupcake toppers to pretty place cards.
